The Opportunity

As a Global Product Manager - Director, you will lead the charge in developing innovative software solutions and driving product innovation to meet the evolving needs of clients. Within our Internal Firm Services practice, you will act as the general manager for commercial and internal products, sitting at the intersection of business, user experience, and technology to solve customer and end-user challenges. Your role involves designing, developing, and managing activities for specific products from definition through production, release, and end of life, confirming they meet market demands and contribute to business growth.

As a Director, you will set the strategic direction and lead business development efforts, making impactful decisions while overseeing multiple projects. You are expected to be a guardian of PwC's reputation, understanding that quality, integrity, inclusion, and a commercial mindset are foundational to our success. You will cultivate potential in others and actively collaborate across the PwC Network, leveraging our collective strength to maximize client satisfaction. In this role, you will drive thought leadership, promote technological advances, and create an environment where people and technology thrive together.

Leading product management initiatives from definition through release and end-of-life stages
Driving business growth by identifying market gaps and converting opportunities into successful products
Translating strategic vision into actionable product roadmaps and inspiring teams to follow
Managing product lifecycle activities including modifications, upgrades, and maintenance
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to align product strategies with business objectives
Utilizing AI fluency and agile methodology to enhance product development processes
Conducting competitive analysis and market research to inform product strategy and pricing
Promoting technological advances and fostering environments where people and technology thrive together
Developing commercialization and go-to-market plans for commercial products
Mentoring and cultivating potential in team members to drive innovation and creativity

At least a Bachelor's degree
At least 9 years of experience

Excelling in Agile Methodology and AI Fluency
Demonstrating proficiency in Product Lifecycle Management and Product Strategy
Utilizing Analytical Thinking and Strategic Planning for business growth
Leading Product Development and Innovation initiatives
Developing comprehensive Product Roadmaps and Marketing Strategies
Cultivating Customer Relationship Management and Satisfaction

jobs.description:
Capital Markets & Analytics - Senior Director, Product Management

Do you want to be part of a team transforming an entire department by discovering business needs, uncovering where value lies, and working with technology, design, subject-matter experts, and finance professionals to create optimal product and platform solutions? Do you want to help lead the creation and growth of an empowered new product management team? Does the idea of seeing your impact directly with internal customers excite you? If so, we want you!

Capital Markets & Analytics Product Management is a unique and high profile space, responsible for discovering, delivering and optimizing products and capabilities that fundamentally transform how our Capital Markets associates work and enable us to deliver valuable insights using modernized technologies and core data services. In addition to your contributions on overall portfolio and product strategies, you’ll also play a key role in building our Product Management organization. You’ll help shape our culture and our people, provide mentorship for your teammates and be an ambassador for Product Management and for the Finance Product & Data Solutions team.

Our product team is part of a larger group focused on the transformation of Finance at Capital One.

This is a unique Capital Markets opportunity to define and execute on a bold product vision from inception! The Product Manager will collaborate closely with customers including: Treasury, Trading, Balance Sheet Management, and Risk & Capital Analytics.

Our key priorities are revolutionizing the Capital Markets and Analytics platform through:

Product Innovation- Delivering innovative products and platforms, driving forward the vision for Capital Markets across balance sheet risk management, treasury, and trading functions.

Optimization- Re-envisioning and streamlining the overall finance experience inclusive of trading, risk management, collateral management and end of month close.

Data Streamlining- Revamping the data ecosystem to consume and leverage streamlined and enriched data end to end.

In the Product Management role, you will:

Establish the vision, strategy, and execution of Treasury, Trading, and bank balance sheet risk management products, data, and services through understanding of the strategic Finance direction and technology architecture and big picture business needs.
Create frameworks for and directly manage the prioritization of the work, capabilities, components, and infrastructures that are used by multiple customer solutions and customer facing products.
Confidently communicate and evangelize product and portfolio strategy across large organizations and executives to influence stakeholders to align behind the objectives
Create and provide frameworks for regularly and systematically using data to uncover opportunities, track product performance, and drive decision making
Prioritize, negotiate and remove blockers to orchestrate successful launch or optimization cycles
Inspire, enable and empower teams to execute with a sense of urgency to deliver solutions and on priorities

What we are looking for:

Proven experience in and passion for ideating, building and implementing great digital products
Experience with Treasury and Capital Markets products and data
Experience in organizational change management including transforming and improving ways of working and interaction models
Deep knowledge of the Product Management discipline and experience in building and maturing Product teams
Strong ability to set a vision and lead, develop and inspire teams to develop innovative products that have high adoption and drive value for internal customers
Exceptional communication skills -- an engaging storyteller at ease presenting to executives
Creative problem solver who provides leadership at the intersection of the human, business and technology dimensions.
Blend of both strategic and tactical thinking -- someone who can identify and prioritize opportunities in highly ambiguous contexts, and then organize work in deep detail; aligning long term vision with iterative execution
Aptitude to champion strategic technology initiatives to leap-frog current constraints and deliver transformational value
Strong quantitative background to support data-informed decision making
Collaborative, team player attitude with the ability to navigate and influence the organization
Superior problem-solving skills with strong strategic, white-spacing thinking
Inspiring people leader

Capital One Product Framework

In this role, you’ll be expected to demonstrate proficiency in five key areas which we consider to be the foundation for successful Product management:

Human Centered - Obsesses about internal and external customer needs to reimagine and innovate product solutions
Business Focused - Delivers game-changing outcomes by focusing on leverage and execution excellence
Technology Driven - Leverages technology to deliver innovative and resilient solutions that enable both near term and long term value
Integrated Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves complex problems to deliver outcomes while mitigating product risks
Transformational Leadership - Leads cross functional teams to solve customer problems and drive organizational alignment

jobs.title: Director, Business Operations — Product & Go-To-Market
jobs.description:
Overview

As Brooklinen continues to grow, how we bring new products from concept to market is more important than ever. We’re hiring a Director, Business Operations — Product & Go-To-Market to strengthen the connection between product development and go-to-market execution—bringing greater clarity, accountability, and momentum across teams.

In this role, you’ll connect the people, processes, and priorities behind our product lifecycle, helping teams stay aligned, navigate complexity, and move work forward from early development through launch.

Reporting to our SVP of Operations, you’ll partner closely with Brooklinen’s executive team and functional leaders to evolve how we operate today and build a more connected, scalable model for the future.

What You’ll Own

Product Development & Launch Orchestration

Drive the cross-functional operating cadence that supports the product development process from concept through launch
Partner closely with Product Development, Merchandising, Production, Creative, Digital, and Marketing teams to align milestones, dependencies, and timelines
Ensure key handoffs across teams are clear, well coordinated, and executed with accountability
Identify areas where the process can move faster or operate more smoothly and lead improvements

Go-to-Market Process Leadership

Strengthen the cross-functional go-to-market process across product, brand, digital, and channel teams
Ensure launches are coordinated across stakeholders with clear ownership and timelines
Partner with marketing, site, and merchandising teams to ensure product launches land smoothly across channels
Act as a central coordinator for launch readiness, keeping teams aligned while maintaining momentum

Cross-Functional Execution & Influence

Lead high-priority initiatives that require coordination across multiple functions and senior stakeholders
Build credibility quickly through strong judgment, subject matter expertise, and a collaborative approach
Navigate competing priorities with objectivity, helping teams make practical tradeoffs in the service of the business
Maintain momentum by identifying risks early and resolving blockers quickly

Operational Excellence & Scale

Strengthen how teams work together across product development and launch by bringing clarity to timelines, handoffs, and decision points
Introduce practical ways of working that improve cross-functional coordination without unnecessary complexity
Translate lessons from launches and initiatives into better ways of operating going forward
Help lay the foundation for a scalable business operations capability over time

What Success Looks Like

Product development and launch timelines feel clear, coordinated, and easier for teams to execute against
Cross-functional partners trust this role’s judgment and view the individual as a valued thought partner
Teams collaborate more smoothly across product, marketing, digital, and operations
Product launches come to market with stronger alignment and fewer last-minute surprises
The organization gains a more consistent and scalable way of bringing products to life

What You Bring

10+ years of experience in business operations, product operations, or cross-functional leadership within consumer brands
Deep expertise in soft goods product development.
You are fluent in how products move from concept through sampling, development, approvals, production, and launch
Experience building or improving cross-functional go-to-market processes
Exceptional relationship-building and influence skills with the ability to establish trust quickly across teams and senior stakeholders
Strong situational leadership and negotiation skills when navigating competing priorities
A builder’s mindset with the ability to introduce structure where needed, while remaining pragmatic and flexible
High standards, strong follow-through, and a bias toward action
Experience working within brands known for strong product development and go-to-market operating models in soft goods, apparel, or consumer goods environments is a plus

Compensation

Base salary range: $165,000–$190,000, plus equity and a 15% target bonus.

Compensation is determined based on experience, skills, and market data.

Benefits & Perks

Up to 100% medical, dental, and vision coverage (employee-only)
Fertility & family-building support (up to $20,000 lifetime)
401(k) with a 4% company match
16 weeks fully paid parental leave
20 vacation days (25 after 5 years) plus year-round Summer Fridays
Hybrid work schedule with two core in-office days (Tues–Thurs)
Remote Thanksgiving week and remote last week of December
Up to four additional remote weeks per year with approval
40% employee discount plus seasonal product allowance
One Medical, Talkspace, and $1,000 per year via Joon for wellness
One-month paid sabbatical at five years

Why Join Us?

Brooklinen is a place where thoughtful people do meaningful work — with warmth, clarity, and shared purpose. We value care, collaboration, balance, and continuous growth. If this role excites you, even if you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply. Diverse experiences and perspectives make us stronger.

About Brooklinen

Brooklinen was founded in 2014 with a simple belief: that comfort can bring happiness. Today, we’re one of the largest soft goods brands in the U.S., designing for real life and real homes with products that pair elevated quality and accessible pricing. Our assortment — from sheets and towels to thoughtful additions for the modern bedroom — has earned over 100,000 five-star reviews and recognition from Architectural Digest, Good Housekeeping, Wirecutter, and more. We’re growing thoughtfully, evolving intentionally, and committed to creating a home for people who care deeply about their craft — and each other.

Turn your streaming obsession into a career— we’re hiring!

About Warner Bros. Discovery

Warner Bros. Discovery is a premier global media and entertainment company. Our Streaming organization builds the products and platform capabilities that help audiences discover, choose, and enjoy great content across connected TV, web, mobile, tablet, and console experiences. Content Discovery sits at the center of that mission, spanning search, recommendations, personalization, ranking, merchandising, and experimentation across a global portfolio of brands and products.  
About the role

We are seeking a Senior Principal Product Manager to lead strategy, vision, and execution for Content Discovery at Warner Bros. Discovery. This is a senior individual   contributor   leadership role with broad influence across product, engineering, data science, design, editorial, marketing, analytics, and executive stakeholders.  
In this role, you will shape the next generation of discovery experiences and services that help users find the right content at the right moment. You will define the strategic direction for a critical product domain,   identify   high-value customer and business problems, and drive a portfolio of initiatives that improve how users discover and choose content across our global streaming products.  
This role requires both strategic range and technical depth. You will   operate   across near-term optimization and long-term innovation, including evaluating how the latest generation of frontier models can re-imagine our content discovery algorithms, user understanding, and decisioning systems. You will help define where these models can create meaningful step-function improvements, where hybrid approaches are   required , and how to bring those capabilities into production in a scalable, measurable, and responsible way.  
Your work will influence core customer   experiences on a   global scale and will be visible to senior leaders across the company.  
The ideal candidate

The ideal candidate has deep experience leading product strategy for ML-driven consumer products at scale, particularly in content discovery, search, recommendations, personalization, ranking, or related domains. You have a strong   track record   of defining strategy in ambiguous spaces, aligning senior stakeholders, and translating complex technical capabilities into products that drive measurable customer and business impact.  
You are equally   comfortable   setting long-term vision, debating technical tradeoffs with engineering and data science, and using experimentation and analysis to sharpen product direction. You bring strong product judgment,   high standards , and a clear point of view on how to build simple, effective experiences on top of sophisticated systems.  
You also have a forward-looking perspective on how frontier AI models can reshape discovery experiences. You understand both the promise and the practical constraints of applying these models to real-world consumer products, and you can distinguish durable product opportunities from short-lived hype.

Define and drive the product strategy for Content Discovery, aligning long-term vision with company goals, user needs, and business priorities.  

Own a multi-horizon roadmap spanning foundational platform investments, user experience improvements, and next-generation discovery capabilities.  

Lead the evaluation and application of the latest frontier models to re-imagine how we understand content, understand user   intent   and taste, and generate more relevant, contextual, and adaptive discovery experiences.  

Identify   where frontier models can materially improve search, recommendations, personalization, ranking, merchandising, and emerging conversational or assistive discovery experiences.  

Partner closely with engineering, data science, design, analytics, editorial, and marketing to translate strategy into product bets, execution plans, and successful launches.  

Identify   and quantify customer pain points and business opportunities through research, experimentation, market understanding, and data analysis.  

Define product principles, success metrics, and experimentation frameworks to guide prioritization and measure impact.  

Drive a user-centered approach to discovery, improving relevance, clarity, usability, and overall customer satisfaction across surfaces and devices.  

Communicate product vision, priorities, tradeoffs, progress, and results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including executive leadership.  

Stay ahead of industry trends, competitive shifts, and advances in AI and machine learning, and translate those signals into product direction and business advantage.  

Raise the quality bar for product thinking, experimentation, and cross-functional decision-making across the broader discovery portfolio.

1 5 + years of product management experience, including   significant experience   in senior-level product leadership roles.  

Deep   expertise   in content discovery, search, recommendations, personalization, ranking, or related ML-driven consumer systems.  

Demonstrated success defining product strategy and leading complex, cross-functional initiatives that drive engagement, satisfaction, and business growth.  

Strong understanding of experimentation, metric design, and data-informed product development.  

Strong technical fluency, with the ability to engage credibly on model, data, system, and platform tradeoffs.  

Experience bringing AI or machine learning capabilities into   production   consumer products, ideally at large scale.  

Strong understanding of the latest generation of AI models and sound judgment about where they can transform product experiences versus where traditional approaches   remain   more effective.  

Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.  

Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead through complexity without direct authority.  

Bachelor’s or Master’s   degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or   a related   field.  

Preferred qualifications

Experience in streaming media, digital entertainment, ecommerce, marketplace, or other   personalization -heavy consumer products.  

Experience working with large-scale experimentation platforms, recommender systems, search and ranking platforms, or related ML infrastructure.  

Experience presenting product strategy, investment tradeoffs, and business impact to senior executives.  

At Warner Bros. Discovery, we are reinventing how people discover and experience television, movies, sports, and news. Content Discovery is central to that transformation. If you are excited to shape the future of discovery through product leadership, machine learning, and frontier AI, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Mobile
jobs.description:
Career Fulfillment & Culture

People come to work for Deque because of what we do: enable businesses and organizations to make their sites and apps accessible to everyone, including people with disabilities. The personal fulfillment employees feel here is unparalleled. In addition to the altruistic nature of our jobs, the organizational structure is extremely flat and welcoming. Women-owned and operated, Deque CEO Preety Kumar is internationally revered for her down-to-earth personality and work ethic. Deque's core values are central to our culture of customer satisfaction. Do you share them?

Innovation with results that matter
Deliver what you promise
Can-do attitude
Open, direct & respectful communications
We care deeply
We practice humility

At Deque, you'll work with the best and brightest minds in the industry, sharing best practices, tackling new issues and uncovering new approaches. Accessibility Consultants at Deque also love their jobs because of the support systems in place.

Deque experts regularly contribute to W3C Accessibility Working Groups and collectively hold more CPACC, WAS, & CPWA certifications issued by the IAAP than any accessibility testing company in the world.

Position Description

The Senior Product Manager is responsible for defining priorities for our mobile product , driving continuous discovery, and ensuring the delivery team is focused on the highest-value work aligned to customer needs and product direction. Because mobile is one part of a broader platform, the role is also accountable for keeping the mobile strategy aligned with Deque's overall platform product strategy and for ensuring that cross-product customer concerns remain consistent across the axe portfolio.

This role serves as the connective point between customers, Product Development, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing. The ideal candidate combines strong customer empathy, situational awareness, and execution discipline in a fast-paced B2B SaaS environment, with a track record of taking ideas from concept to launch.

Primary Responsibilities

Continuously engage with customers, users, Sales, Support, and Customer Success to be the embodiment of the product's target market for the rest of the development team.
Ensure the development team is clear on the highest-priority work to be done, and that it's clearly defined against the product vision, competitive landscape, and customer needs.
Provide Product Marketing Management with the information they need to effectively enable sales, customer success, and channel partners.
Represent the product internally and externally to customers, Sales, and Customer Success.
Act as the voice of the customer and target market for Product Development and cross-functional teams.
Work closely with Engineering Managers to ensure the team is effective at iterating quickly to make the product more competitive and valuable.
Define and communicate product requirements, priorities, business outcomes, and release objectives.
Partner closely with Product Development throughout discovery, validation, delivery, and iteration cycles.
Collaborate with Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to support positioning, enablement, and launches.
Monitor customer feedback and product performance to inform prioritization.
Communicate priorities and progress clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Create the quarterly product roadmap proposals, run the meeting with the stakeholders to finalize the quarterly roadmap, be accountable for the roadmap delivery
Work with the product owner and senior technical staff to prioritize work for the team(s) from sprint-to-sprint. Be accountable for the priorities.
Manage product owner(s) and/or junior product manager(s): set clear expectations, coach to high performance, and address underperformance directly
Work with the engineering manager(s) on staffing and managing the technical team members
Contribute to the advancement and improvement of the product management discipline at Deque. Give input into the platform product strategy and keep the mobile product strategy aligned with it, including keeping cross-customer concerns (for example, analysis results) consistent across products.
Create and maintain the competitive radar-scope for mobile, propose and maintain market-traction metrics, and regularly form and share a view of where the market is heading, using it to inform strategy and prioritization.
Present to industry analysts and represent Deque and the mobile product as the leader in the space.
Enable the organization: train Sales and Solutions Engineers on value, competitive positioning, features and demos; train Product Success (Technical Solutions Architects and Implementation Engineers) on successful rollout; and, with the Product Owner, train Help Desk Engineers on installation and support.
Run the product forum for the mobile product.
Create and maintain product Intranet content and contribute to sales collateral.
Advocate for and implement marketing and sales campaigns that improve sales of the product, and support Sales in large sales situations and Services in large rollouts.
Understand team efficiency relative to industry and company benchmarks, work with Engineering Managers and Product Owners to measure and improve team effectiveness, and foster a culture of team output over individual output.
Form direct relationships with users at lead customers.

Requirements

4–7 years of product management experience in a B2B SaaS environment, with a proven track record of successful product launches.
Experience partnering with direct sales organizations, including Account Executives and Solutions Engineers.
Worked closely with Product Development team members as primary users/stakeholders.
Experience balancing customer demands, competitive pressures, and the need to progress toward product vision.
Experience articulating the value proposition of the product to both internal and external audiences.
Comfortable identifying and tracking competitive products and market positioning.
History of direct customer engagement, including discovery conversations and product feedback sessions.
Experience working at a fully remote company is a plus.

Additional Skills

Continuous discovery
Customer empathy and advocacy
Engaging users and customers in product development
Using AI tools for Product Management work
Using AI coding tools to create working prototypes
Clear communicator and collaborative team player

About Deque

Deque (pronounced dee-cue) is a web accessibility software and services company, and our mission is Digital Equality. We believe everyone, regardless of their ability, should have equal access to the information, services, applications, and everything else on the web.

We work with enterprise-level businesses and organizations to ensure that their sites and mobile apps are accessible. With over 475,000 extensions installed and over 5,000 audit projects completed, Deque is the industry standard. Join our growing family as we work to make the web a better place for everyone.

Remote

Apply by submitting your resume and a cover letter. Applications without a cover letter will not be considered.

In Your Cover Letter

Explain your interest in joining Deque and how you align with our Core Values
Depict key attributes that differentiate you as a candidate

Deque is committed to providing Equal Employment Opportunities. Reference and background checks will be required. jobs.title: Product Manager/Sr. Product Manager (Telephony & Voice) - Remote (26-20)
jobs.description:
Description

Spok is looking for a self-directed and entrepreneurial Product Manager to own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for our telephony and voice product lines, and manage the strategy and implementations of related partnerships. Telephony is the foundation everything else in our platform depends on: PBX interoperability, call control, routing, and the CTI layer that ties voice infrastructure into the applications our customers use every day, including the Spok Operator Console that healthcare contact centers rely on for code calls, paging, and on-call workflows.

This role is primarily about telephony native capabilities, depth and strategy, the platforms we integrate with (including with partners), where we invest, and how we stay ahead of shifts in the market (PBX vendors, CCaaS/UCaaS platforms, cloud voice). Contact center and operator console workflows are an important downstream consumer of that strategy, and you'll partner closely with the product and development teams who own those experiences to ensure Spok’s portfolio remains the leader in critical communications.

What You'll Own

Telephony, voice strategy, related AI-strategy and roadmap

>Define and own the multi-year telephony and voice product strategy, PBX interoperability (Cisco, Avaya and others), call routing, voice quality/reliability, and call-control architecture. This role will also be firmly required to have a position on where we do not pursue partnerships or technology integrations based on market, customer and Spok enterprise strategy.

>Become a knowledge expert on how Spok CTI and Spok Operator Contact Centers, combined, are a differentiated experience compared to competitors; must craft engagement with marketing to evangelize and expand thought-leadership.

>Prioritize release schedule and roadmap for telephony platforms and protocols based on market demand, technical feasibility, and customer impact.

>Build the business case for telephony and voice initiatives, including market sizing, competitive positioning, pricing strategy and expected outcomes.

>Track the competitive and vendor landscape (PBX vendors, CCaaS/UCaaS platforms, cloud voice trends) and translate shifts into roadmap implications and build-vs-partner-vs-buy decisions.

>Maintain a detailed working knowledge of the broader UCaaS and CCaaS market, major players (e.g., Genesys, NICE, Five9, RingCentral, 8x8, Cisco Webex, Microsoft Teams, Talkdesk, Amazon Connect), their platform strategies, and where the market is consolidating or shifting, and use that knowledge to inform where Spok should build, integrate, or partner.

>Serve as the internal expert on telephony and voice, the person leadership, sales, and delivery teams turn to for direction and answers.

>Partner with Platform Product Managers on topics, including but not limited to, CTI/Telephony Epics, Stories and all aspects of the PDLC.

>Customer experience as it relates to existing and future products, you must be willing and able to engage with clients at a senior level as well as working team level.

>Understand and exploit AI capabilities of partners and Spok platform, as appropriate to deliver market-driven solutions.

>Define and document the roadmap and backlog priority through Confluence, Jira and related tooling; own the product roadmap for the enterprise.

CTI and integration architecture

>Own requirements for CTI and call-control integration across major telephony platforms and protocols (e.g., SIP, CSTA/TSAPI/TAPI, and vendor-specific APIs).

>Partner with technical product managers, engineering on CTI middleware, call-control interfaces, presence, and event handling, including how those events surface into downstream applications.

>Balance depth of integration against maintainability and the realities of supporting many customer telephony environments.

>Ensure telephony and CTI integrations meet the reliability and availability expectations of a mission-critical hospital environment.

Partner strategy and collaboration

>Define and own the telephony partner strategy, which PBX and cloud platform vendors we integrate with, how deeply, and in what priority; all while maintaining and expanding Spok’s leading IP and market position.

>Build and maintain strategic and working relationships with partner product and engineering teams to align roadmaps, resolve integration issues, and unlock new capabilities.

>Evaluate potential UCaaS and CCaaS partnerships, assessing platform fit, competitive overlap, and integration depth, and make clear build-vs-partner recommendations to leadership.

>Represent Spok in joint technical planning, certification programs, and co-development efforts.

Contact center and operator workflow collaboration (secondary focus)

>Partner with the product team(s) owning the Operator Console and contact center workflows to make sure telephony and CTI capabilities support what operators need, screen pop, call answer/hold/transfer/conference, ANI/DNIS-based routing, directory tie-ins, and call logging.

>Provide telephony and CTI input into operator workflow design, particularly for high-volume, high-stakes scenarios (code calls, mass notification, disaster events).

Go-to-market and delivery enablement

>Partner with marketing, sales engineering, professional services, support and other enablement teams to position telephony and CTI capabilities and support the sales cycle.

>Conduct sales, services, support training as required for releases and partner with technical product management to deliver comprehensive insights on the capabilities.

Who We Are

Impiricus is the Agentic Commercialization Platform for Healthcare. We help life sciences teams understand physician intent, coordinate the right clinical and commercial resources, and enable real-time action when HCPs need support. Our AI-powered platform acts as a field force multiplier: extending reach between rep visits, prioritizing the highest-impact path for each physician, and connecting HCPs to coverage, evidence, medical information, patient support, MSLs, field teams, samples, and approved content in the moments that matter.
Founded by a practicing physician and a senior pharmaceutical executive, Impiricus was built to accelerate patient access to life-saving treatments through ethical, physician-first engagement. More than one million opted-in HCPs trust Impiricus as a preferred channel, including many who are underserved or hard to reach through traditional outreach. Products such as the Intelligently Optimized Network (ION), Pulse, Spark, and Ascend work together so every interaction can move from information to action. Guided by our Physician Advisory Board, we keep engagement clinically meaningful, compliant, and grounded in better patient care.

Job Summary

The Director, Product Design is a player-coach role: the team, the practice, and hands-on work on the most impactful product surfaces. That means user discovery, UX, UI, prototyping, and the standards that keep experiences coherent across mobile, web, and platform.

Marketing owns brand design, marketing creative, and the corporate website. This role does not. Everything here is product: what HCPs, patients, and internal users see and do in Ascend, DocUpdate, Curate, and the internal tools our teams build on, including the homegrown AI surfaces that ship inside the product org.

The Director runs discovery with users, sets the bar for craft, and manages designers as the function grows. AI is part of the job, not a side project. The team designs AI-assisted and agentic product experiences, and maintains the design framework (components, patterns, tokens, interaction rules) so it can be applied in product UI and incorporated into internal AI build tools, including Sage and other homegrown platforms.

On product teams, this role is the design partner in the triad with the product lead and engineering lead. PM experience helps but is not required. Running discovery and operating as a peer to PM and engineering is.

Product Design Leadership

Cover mobile, consumer-grade interaction where it applies, and complex health tech platform work in one practice.

User Discovery

Turn research and feedback into design direction the product team can act on.

Experience across mobile and web, including platform or multi-surface products.

This multi-billion dollar market has been overlooked for decades, left to cobble together solutions that slow them down instead of helping them grow.

Quo is changing that. We bring calls, texts, and customer information together into one easy-to-use, AI-powered platform. We’re not just building a phone system. We’re setting a new standard for how businesses connect with their customers.

About The Role

Quo runs a real-time communications platform, and everything our customers experience — calls that connect instantly, messages that deliver reliably, integrations that just work — rests on infrastructure that has to be fast, resilient, and boring in the best possible way. This role owns the product direction for the two teams that make that possible: Scale & Reliability
and Platform Engineering
.

You'll treat platform and infrastructure as a product, with developer efficiency,reducing infrastructure-driven incidents and development risk
as your North Star. You'll set roadmap and priorities across reliability investment and platform capabilities, partner deeply with senior engineering leaders, negotiate with peer PMs, and make the hard tradeoffs between velocity, cost, and resilience explicit and defensible. You'll be the connective tissue across engineering, product, and design, a force multiplier who turns strategy into a sequenced, funded, and delivered roadmap, keeping complex, multi-team programs on track from scoping through launch and retrospective.

This is a technical PM role. You won't write the code, but you'll be fluent in the architecture, comfortable in a design review, and credible with staff and principal engineers.

Some Of The Things You’ll Do

Own the business case for Platform — represent the team's priorities to executives and hold the roadmap accountable to measurable outcomes, not just delivery.
Own reliability as a product discipline — Service Level Objectives and platform health observability to reduce errors and incidents across our services, and negotiate with peer PMs to balance velocity with stability.
Build for the future — capacity planning ahead of growth, and the product side of incident management, from postmortem to funded fix.
Set the internal developer platform roadmap — paved paths, shared services, and self-serve tooling — with developer velocity and adoption as first-class metrics.
Hold the line on real-time performance — latency and media quality where milliseconds are the product.
Steer on the metrics that matter — uptime, latency, incident load, adoption, unit cost — using data and judgment to decide when to slow down and when to ship, and to make that case to product, engineering, and finance alike.
Run intake and prioritization of the Platform backlog — balancing business needs, technical requirements, and team capacity, and partnering with engineering leads to plan and staff initiatives.
Surface risks early and drive resolution — proactively identify technical risks, capacity constraints, and architectural gaps, and escalate to leadership with clear context and a recommended path forward.

About You

5+ years in product management, including meaningful time as a technical, platform, or infrastructure PM (or an eng/SRE-to-PM path ).
Technical fluency in distributed systems — you can hold your own on architecture, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and the failure modes of systems at scale.
Hands-on experience with Service Level Objective frameworks, on-call, and incident management — you've lived the reliability lifecycle with an at-scale service.
A platform-as-a-product mindset: you understand that internal developers are customers, and that adoption is earned.
Strong partnership skills with staff/principal engineers and engineering leaders — you build trust through clear thinking and technical credibility.
Data-driven and outcome-oriented, with the judgment to know which metric is actually the one that matters.
High ownership mentality — you treat the programs you run as your own and do what it takes to make them succeed.

Nice to have

Background in real-time systems, telephony/VoIP/CPaaS, or messaging — or in another domain where high-availability, multi-tenant, latency-sensitive infrastructure is non-negotiable (e.g., identity/security, payments, streaming).
Experience standing up or scaling an internal developer platform.
Familiarity with cost/efficiency optimization at cloud scale.
Exposure to compliance-driven delivery (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, ISO 27001).

Salary is just one component of Quo’s total compensation package. Your total rewards package will include equity, extensive medical coverage, a monthly lifestyle stipend, and a flexible PTO policy.

We're a remote-first company with a culture of trust, autonomy, and action. If you're looking for a place to do your best work, we'd love to hear from you.

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. While audiences binge award-winning content, breaking news, and sports around the clock, our teams stay busy at work creating what’s next in streaming. From Succession, Euphoria, and The Sopranos to global franchises like Game of Thrones and Harry Potter, our content sparks conversation and shapes culture.

HBO Max delivers boundary-pushing stories across genres and platforms, connecting millions of viewers across 90 countries globally— and we’re just getting started. We're home to the most talked about shows and movies, granting audiences access to the worlds of HBO, Harry Potter, DC, Warner Bros., ID, Adult Swim, A24, and more. Turn your streaming obsession into a career— we’re hiring!

About Warner Bros. Discovery

Warner Bros. Discovery is a premier global media and entertainment company. Our Streaming organization builds the products and platform capabilities that help audiences discover, choose, and enjoy great content across connected TV, web, mobile, tablet, and console experiences. Content Discovery sits at the center of that mission, spanning search, recommendations, personalization, ranking, merchandising, and experimentation across a global portfolio of brands and products.  
About the role

We are seeking a Senior Principal Product Manager to lead strategy, vision, and execution for Content Discovery at Warner Bros. Discovery. This is a senior individual   contributor   leadership role with broad influence across product, engineering, data science, design, editorial, marketing, analytics, and executive stakeholders.  
In this role, you will shape the next generation of discovery experiences and services that help users find the right content at the right moment. You will define the strategic direction for a critical product domain,   identify   high-value customer and business problems, and drive a portfolio of initiatives that improve how users discover and choose content across our global streaming products.  
This role requires both strategic range and technical depth. You will   operate   across near-term optimization and long-term innovation, including evaluating how the latest generation of frontier models can re-imagine our content discovery algorithms, user understanding, and decisioning systems. You will help define where these models can create meaningful step-function improvements, where hybrid approaches are   required , and how to bring those capabilities into production in a scalable, measurable, and responsible way.  
Your work will influence core customer   experiences on a   global scale and will be visible to senior leaders across the company.  
The ideal candidate

The ideal candidate has deep experience leading product strategy for ML-driven consumer products at scale, particularly in content discovery, search, recommendations, personalization, ranking, or related domains. You have a strong   track record   of defining strategy in ambiguous spaces, aligning senior stakeholders, and translating complex technical capabilities into products that drive measurable customer and business impact.  
You are equally   comfortable   setting long-term vision, debating technical tradeoffs with engineering and data science, and using experimentation and analysis to sharpen product direction. You bring strong product judgment,   high standards , and a clear point of view on how to build simple, effective experiences on top of sophisticated systems.  
You also have a forward-looking perspective on how frontier AI models can reshape discovery experiences. You understand both the promise and the practical constraints of applying these models to real-world consumer products, and you can distinguish durable product opportunities from short-lived hype.  
What you will do

Define and drive the product strategy for Content Discovery, aligning long-term vision with company goals, user needs, and business priorities.  

Own a multi-horizon roadmap spanning foundational platform investments, user experience improvements, and next-generation discovery capabilities.  

Lead the evaluation and application of the latest frontier models to re-imagine how we understand content, understand user   intent   and taste, and generate more relevant, contextual, and adaptive discovery experiences.  

Identify   where frontier models can materially improve search, recommendations, personalization, ranking, merchandising, and emerging conversational or assistive discovery experiences.  

Partner closely with engineering, data science, design, analytics, editorial, and marketing to translate strategy into product bets, execution plans, and successful launches.  

Identify   and quantify customer pain points and business opportunities through research, experimentation, market understanding, and data analysis.  

Define product principles, success metrics, and experimentation frameworks to guide prioritization and measure impact.  

Drive a user-centered approach to discovery, improving relevance, clarity, usability, and overall customer satisfaction across surfaces and devices.  

Communicate product vision, priorities, tradeoffs, progress, and results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including executive leadership.  

Stay ahead of industry trends, competitive shifts, and advances in AI and machine learning, and translate those signals into product direction and business advantage.  

Raise the quality bar for product thinking, experimentation, and cross-functional decision-making across the broader discovery portfolio.  

Qualifications

1 5 + years of product management experience, including   significant experience   in senior-level product leadership roles.  

Deep   expertise   in content discovery, search, recommendations, personalization, ranking, or related ML-driven consumer systems.  

Demonstrated success defining product strategy and leading complex, cross-functional initiatives that drive engagement, satisfaction, and business growth.  

Strong understanding of experimentation, metric design, and data-informed product development.  

Strong technical fluency, with the ability to engage credibly on model, data, system, and platform tradeoffs.  

Experience bringing AI or machine learning capabilities into   production   consumer products, ideally at large scale.  

Strong understanding of the latest generation of AI models and sound judgment about where they can transform product experiences versus where traditional approaches   remain   more effective.  

Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.  

Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead through complexity without direct authority.  

Bachelor’s or Master’s   degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or   a related   field.  

Preferred qualifications

Experience in streaming media, digital entertainment, ecommerce, marketplace, or other   personalization -heavy consumer products.  

Experience working with large-scale experimentation platforms, recommender systems, search and ranking platforms, or related ML infrastructure.  

Experience presenting product strategy, investment tradeoffs, and business impact to senior executives.  

At Warner Bros. Discovery, we are reinventing how people discover and experience television, movies, sports, and news. Content Discovery is central to that transformation. If you are excited to shape the future of discovery through product leadership, machine learning, and frontier AI, we would love to hear from you.

new_jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Mobile
new_jobs.description:
Career Fulfillment & Culture

People come to work for Deque because of what we do: enable businesses and organizations to make their sites and apps accessible to everyone, including people with disabilities. The personal fulfillment employees feel here is unparalleled. In addition to the altruistic nature of our jobs, the organizational structure is extremely flat and welcoming. Women-owned and operated, Deque CEO Preety Kumar is internationally revered for her down-to-earth personality and work ethic. Deque's core values are central to our culture of customer satisfaction. Do you share them?

Innovation with results that matter
Deliver what you promise
Can-do attitude
Open, direct & respectful communications
We care deeply
We practice humility

At Deque, you'll work with the best and brightest minds in the industry, sharing best practices, tackling new issues and uncovering new approaches. Accessibility Consultants at Deque also love their jobs because of the support systems in place.

Deque experts regularly contribute to W3C Accessibility Working Groups and collectively hold more CPACC, WAS, & CPWA certifications issued by the IAAP than any accessibility testing company in the world.

Position Description

The Senior Product Manager is responsible for defining priorities for our mobile product , driving continuous discovery, and ensuring the delivery team is focused on the highest-value work aligned to customer needs and product direction. Because mobile is one part of a broader platform, the role is also accountable for keeping the mobile strategy aligned with Deque's overall platform product strategy and for ensuring that cross-product customer concerns remain consistent across the axe portfolio.

This role serves as the connective point between customers, Product Development, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing. The ideal candidate combines strong customer empathy, situational awareness, and execution discipline in a fast-paced B2B SaaS environment, with a track record of taking ideas from concept to launch.

Primary Responsibilities

Continuously engage with customers, users, Sales, Support, and Customer Success to be the embodiment of the product's target market for the rest of the development team.
Ensure the development team is clear on the highest-priority work to be done, and that it's clearly defined against the product vision, competitive landscape, and customer needs.
Provide Product Marketing Management with the information they need to effectively enable sales, customer success, and channel partners.
Represent the product internally and externally to customers, Sales, and Customer Success.
Act as the voice of the customer and target market for Product Development and cross-functional teams.
Work closely with Engineering Managers to ensure the team is effective at iterating quickly to make the product more competitive and valuable.
Define and communicate product requirements, priorities, business outcomes, and release objectives.
Partner closely with Product Development throughout discovery, validation, delivery, and iteration cycles.
Collaborate with Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to support positioning, enablement, and launches.
Monitor customer feedback and product performance to inform prioritization.
Communicate priorities and progress clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Create the quarterly product roadmap proposals, run the meeting with the stakeholders to finalize the quarterly roadmap, be accountable for the roadmap delivery
Work with the product owner and senior technical staff to prioritize work for the team(s) from sprint-to-sprint. Be accountable for the priorities.
Manage product owner(s) and/or junior product manager(s): set clear expectations, coach to high performance, and address underperformance directly
Work with the engineering manager(s) on staffing and managing the technical team members
Contribute to the advancement and improvement of the product management discipline at Deque. Give input into the platform product strategy and keep the mobile product strategy aligned with it, including keeping cross-customer concerns (for example, analysis results) consistent across products.
Create and maintain the competitive radar-scope for mobile, propose and maintain market-traction metrics, and regularly form and share a view of where the market is heading, using it to inform strategy and prioritization.
Present to industry analysts and represent Deque and the mobile product as the leader in the space.
Enable the organization: train Sales and Solutions Engineers on value, competitive positioning, features and demos; train Product Success (Technical Solutions Architects and Implementation Engineers) on successful rollout; and, with the Product Owner, train Help Desk Engineers on installation and support.
Run the product forum for the mobile product.
Create and maintain product Intranet content and contribute to sales collateral.
Advocate for and implement marketing and sales campaigns that improve sales of the product, and support Sales in large sales situations and Services in large rollouts.
Understand team efficiency relative to industry and company benchmarks, work with Engineering Managers and Product Owners to measure and improve team effectiveness, and foster a culture of team output over individual output.
Form direct relationships with users at lead customers.

Requirements

4–7 years of product management experience in a B2B SaaS environment, with a proven track record of successful product launches.
Experience partnering with direct sales organizations, including Account Executives and Solutions Engineers.
Worked closely with Product Development team members as primary users/stakeholders.
Experience balancing customer demands, competitive pressures, and the need to progress toward product vision.
Experience articulating the value proposition of the product to both internal and external audiences.
Comfortable identifying and tracking competitive products and market positioning.
History of direct customer engagement, including discovery conversations and product feedback sessions.
Experience working at a fully remote company is a plus.

Additional Skills

Continuous discovery
Customer empathy and advocacy
Engaging users and customers in product development
Using AI tools for Product Management work
Using AI coding tools to create working prototypes
Clear communicator and collaborative team player

About Deque

Deque (pronounced dee-cue) is a web accessibility software and services company, and our mission is Digital Equality. We believe everyone, regardless of their ability, should have equal access to the information, services, applications, and everything else on the web.

We work with enterprise-level businesses and organizations to ensure that their sites and mobile apps are accessible. With over 475,000 extensions installed and over 5,000 audit projects completed, Deque is the industry standard. Join our growing family as we work to make the web a better place for everyone.

Job Location

Remote

How to Apply

Apply by submitting your resume and a cover letter. Applications without a cover letter will not be considered.

In Your Cover Letter

Explain your interest in joining Deque and how you align with our Core Values
Depict key attributes that differentiate you as a candidate

Deque is committed to providing Equal Employment Opportunities. Reference and background checks will be required. The expected salary range is $160,000–$185,000 but is subject to change based on the skills, abilities, and experience of each candidate. The values listed are not intended to guarantee a salary for candidates or current employees.

Thank you for your interest in joining our exciting company!

new_jobs.description:
Description

Spok is looking for a self-directed and entrepreneurial Product Manager to own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for our telephony and voice product lines, and manage the strategy and implementations of related partnerships. Telephony is the foundation everything else in our platform depends on: PBX interoperability, call control, routing, and the CTI layer that ties voice infrastructure into the applications our customers use every day, including the Spok Operator Console that healthcare contact centers rely on for code calls, paging, and on-call workflows.

Who We Are

Impiricus is the Agentic Commercialization Platform for Healthcare. We help life sciences teams understand physician intent, coordinate the right clinical and commercial resources, and enable real-time action when HCPs need support. Our AI-powered platform acts as a field force multiplier: extending reach between rep visits, prioritizing the highest-impact path for each physician, and connecting HCPs to coverage, evidence, medical information, patient support, MSLs, field teams, samples, and approved content in the moments that matter.
Founded by a practicing physician and a senior pharmaceutical executive, Impiricus was built to accelerate patient access to life-saving treatments through ethical, physician-first engagement. More than one million opted-in HCPs trust Impiricus as a preferred channel, including many who are underserved or hard to reach through traditional outreach. Products such as the Intelligently Optimized Network (ION), Pulse, Spark, and Ascend work together so every interaction can move from information to action. Guided by our Physician Advisory Board, we keep engagement clinically meaningful, compliant, and grounded in better patient care.

Job Summary

The Director, Product Design is a player-coach role: the team, the practice, and hands-on work on the most impactful product surfaces. That means user discovery, UX, UI, prototyping, and the standards that keep experiences coherent across mobile, web, and platform.

Marketing owns brand design, marketing creative, and the corporate website. This role does not. Everything here is product: what HCPs, patients, and internal users see and do in Ascend, DocUpdate, Curate, and the internal tools our teams build on, including the homegrown AI surfaces that ship inside the product org.

The Director runs discovery with users, sets the bar for craft, and manages designers as the function grows. AI is part of the job, not a side project. The team designs AI-assisted and agentic product experiences, and maintains the design framework (components, patterns, tokens, interaction rules) so it can be applied in product UI and incorporated into internal AI build tools, including Sage and other homegrown platforms.

On product teams, this role is the design partner in the triad with the product lead and engineering lead. PM experience helps but is not required. Running discovery and operating as a peer to PM and engineering is.

Key Responsibilities

Product Design Leadership
Own product design across the portfolio and set the bar for the function.
Stay hands-on on the highest-stakes surfaces when the team needs senior design depth.
Hold released product to a consistent standard for clarity, accessibility, and workflow fit.
Cover mobile, consumer-grade interaction where it applies, and complex health tech platform work in one practice.

User Discovery
Plan and run user discovery with HCPs, patients, and internal users, and hold the team to the same bar on their surfaces.
Turn research and feedback into design direction the product team can act on.
Build durable understanding of physician and operator workflow and bring it into roadmap conversations early.
Partner with Product on measurement so experience changes can be judged after launch.

Design System, Framework, and AI Design
Own the product design system: components, patterns, tokens, and how they are governed in production.
Maintain and extend the design framework so standards stay usable in code and in AI-assisted build flows, including homegrown tools the company builds on.
Design AI-powered product experiences where the roadmap requires them: conversational flows, agent interactions, and the UX guardrails that keep those surfaces trustworthy in a regulated context.
Partner with AI and engineering leadership on platform and builder UI so design quality does not stop at traditional product screens.
Establish critique, review, and quality standards for the whole design team, including work on AI surfaces.

Cross-Functional Partnership
Partner with the product lead(s) and engineering lead(s) from discovery through delivery on each scrum team.
Represent design in product planning so experience risk and opportunity show up before build starts.
Partner with Engineering on feasibility, implementation fidelity, and front-end delivery.
Partner with Compliance and MLR where regulatory requirements shape product UI, including fair balance and required disclosure in the interface.

Qualifications & Experience

7+ years in product design with a portfolio of complex, workflow-heavy shipped products.
Experience across mobile and web, including platform or multi-surface products.
Health tech, life sciences, or other regulated product design experience strongly preferred.
Track record owning a design system or framework in production, not a library that never shipped.
Experience designing for AI-assisted, conversational, or agentic product surfaces, or equivalent platform/builder UI.
Track record running user discovery, not only taking requirements from PM.
Experience managing designers or standing up a small design function.
Strong hands-on craft in interaction design, visual design, and prototyping; comfortable as a player-coach, not a manager who stepped out of the work.
Credible partner to product and engineering leadership without needing to own the PM role.
Product management experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Compensation and Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $180,000 - $200,000
Where you land within the range will reflect your skills, experience, and location, while keeping team parity in mind and leaving room for future growth.

Small businesses represent 99.9% of all companies, yet they're still forced to choose between clunky, outdated enterprise phone systems or their personal phones. This multi-billion dollar market has been overlooked for decades, left to cobble together solutions that slow them down instead of helping them grow.

Quo is changing that. We bring calls, texts, and customer information together into one easy-to-use, AI-powered platform. We’re not just building a phone system. We’re setting a new standard for how businesses connect with their customers.

Driven by our values, we move fast, build with determination, and obsess over delivering value to the businesses that have been underserved for far too long.

Today, Quo is trusted by more than 120,000 companies and rated #1 in customer satisfaction on G2. We’re backed by Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Craft Ventures, Slow Ventures, and other top-tier investors. It’s safe to say we’re onto something big.

About The Role

Quo runs a real-time communications platform, and everything our customers experience — calls that connect instantly, messages that deliver reliably, integrations that just work — rests on infrastructure that has to be fast, resilient, and boring in the best possible way. This role owns the product direction for the two teams that make that possible: Scale & Reliability
and Platform Engineering
.

You'll treat platform and infrastructure as a product, with developer efficiency,reducing infrastructure-driven incidents and development risk
as your North Star. You'll set roadmap and priorities across reliability investment and platform capabilities, partner deeply with senior engineering leaders, negotiate with peer PMs, and make the hard tradeoffs between velocity, cost, and resilience explicit and defensible. You'll be the connective tissue across engineering, product, and design, a force multiplier who turns strategy into a sequenced, funded, and delivered roadmap, keeping complex, multi-team programs on track from scoping through launch and retrospective.

This is a technical PM role. You won't write the code, but you'll be fluent in the architecture, comfortable in a design review, and credible with staff and principal engineers.

Some Of The Things You’ll Do

Own the business case for Platform — represent the team's priorities to executives and hold the roadmap accountable to measurable outcomes, not just delivery.
Own reliability as a product discipline — Service Level Objectives and platform health observability to reduce errors and incidents across our services, and negotiate with peer PMs to balance velocity with stability.
Build for the future — capacity planning ahead of growth, and the product side of incident management, from postmortem to funded fix.
Set the internal developer platform roadmap — paved paths, shared services, and self-serve tooling — with developer velocity and adoption as first-class metrics.
Hold the line on real-time performance — latency and media quality where milliseconds are the product.
Steer on the metrics that matter — uptime, latency, incident load, adoption, unit cost — using data and judgment to decide when to slow down and when to ship, and to make that case to product, engineering, and finance alike.
Run intake and prioritization of the Platform backlog — balancing business needs, technical requirements, and team capacity, and partnering with engineering leads to plan and staff initiatives.
Surface risks early and drive resolution — proactively identify technical risks, capacity constraints, and architectural gaps, and escalate to leadership with clear context and a recommended path forward.

About You

5+ years in product management, including meaningful time as a technical, platform, or infrastructure PM (or an eng/SRE-to-PM path ).
Technical fluency in distributed systems — you can hold your own on architecture, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and the failure modes of systems at scale.
Hands-on experience with Service Level Objective frameworks, on-call, and incident management — you've lived the reliability lifecycle with an at-scale service.
A platform-as-a-product mindset: you understand that internal developers are customers, and that adoption is earned.
Strong partnership skills with staff/principal engineers and engineering leaders — you build trust through clear thinking and technical credibility.
Data-driven and outcome-oriented, with the judgment to know which metric is actually the one that matters.
High ownership mentality — you treat the programs you run as your own and do what it takes to make them succeed.

Nice to have

Background in real-time systems, telephony/VoIP/CPaaS, or messaging — or in another domain where high-availability, multi-tenant, latency-sensitive infrastructure is non-negotiable (e.g., identity/security, payments, streaming).
Experience standing up or scaling an internal developer platform.
Familiarity with cost/efficiency optimization at cloud scale.
Exposure to compliance-driven delivery (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, ISO 27001).

Compensation

The annual base salary range for this position in the US is $165,000 - $194,000 USD, and in Canada is $166,000 - $196,000 CAD, plus equity and benefits. This range is designed to align with market rates in areas where we are actively recruiting across the US and Canada.

The range displayed reflects the target for new hire salaries, and within this range, individual pay is determined by your skills and experience, as well as relevant education. Your recruiter can share more and answer questions about the specific salary range during the hiring process.

Salary is just one component of Quo’s total compensation package. Your total rewards package will include equity, extensive medical coverage, a monthly lifestyle stipend, and a flexible PTO policy.

We're a remote-first company with a culture of trust, autonomy, and action. As we rapidly grow, we're intentionally building communities in a handful of hub cities while continuing to hire great talent wherever they happen to live. If you're looking for a place to do your best work, we'd love to hear from you.

And remember, there's no such thing as a 'perfect' candidate. We're looking for optimists with grit and determination, who are excited to face the challenges of a growing startup. Quo is the type of company where you can grow, and we encourage you to apply for this role even if you don't think you meet all the requirements.

About Supercircle

Supercircle is the AI-powered operating system for recovering value from billions of unsold and post-sale products across global retail. Brands lose $170B a year to returned, damaged, and excess inventory, and 60% of products and clothing are burned or landfilled within a year of manufacture date. We are unlocking waste as a value generator rather than a cost center, building a new reverse logistics economy for the world’s leading brands.
Our AI-powered platform is already the de facto partner for the enterprise market trusted by 100+ brands including J.Crew, VF Corp, GUESS, Reformation, FIGS and Parachute, and has already orchestrated the diversion of 12M+ products from t-shirts to basketballs from landfill while returning $50M+ to our partners' P&Ls.
Supercircle is a leading venture backed company in NYC that has raised $40M+ to date from top VCs, including a $24M Series A led by Foundry in 2025 and continuing to grow even faster as we move towards our next round.
Led by multi-time co-founders in tech, retail, fashion, and supply chain, Supercircle’s stacked team includes one of the former founders at Gilt Groupe and operators from companies including Flexport, eBay, Equinox, Gap, The RealReal, Afterpay, Meta and Google.
We are building the rails for an industry that has, until now, run on spreadsheets and pallets — and we're just getting started on the $170B+ in unmanaged inventory and unrecovered value sitting on brands' balance sheets.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Supercircle's Recovery OS, an AI platform that helps leading retail brands turn returns, damages, excess, and consumer trade-ins into value that makes circularity work at scale.
That means: The full B2B experience for the largest brands in the world to manage the intelligent recovery of millions of items and the proprietary warehouse tools used in our facilities to intelligently intake, sort, and route every item to the right place. We are the system of record that captures item-level data with a full, auditable chain of custody, and provides a reporting and value-realization layer that brand finance, sustainability, and compliance teams depend on.

What You'll Own

AI-Driven System of Action

Partner with engineering on customer-facing and internal AI capabilities, including automated intake, smart sorting, and intelligent routing.
Leverage AI-first tools and methodologies to accelerate product discovery, prototyping, and operational execution.

Value Realization & ROI Reporting

Build customer-facing analytics and reporting suites that clearly quantify financial returns, compliance tracking, and sustainability ROI for partner brands.
Continue to accelerate Recovery OS as an indispensable system of record aligned with emerging global compliance, duty, and regulatory standards.

Warehouse Processing & Operator Experience

Drive frontline software user experience to maximize operator efficiency, processing speed, and accuracy across physical recovery operations.
Own key operational throughput metrics, quality assurance, and overall platform adoption within warehouse environments.

System of Record & Data Integrity

Architect and maintain a scalable item-level data schema to strengthen an audit-ready chain of custody across the product lifecycle.
Automate data capture mechanisms to ensure enterprise-grade reliability and precision for executive-level brand reporting.

Platform Configurability & Scalability

Standardize and unify disparate workflows into a highly configurable, protocol-driven platform to streamline enterprise onboarding.
Design self-serve and administrative tools that reduce custom engineering effort when expanding partner integration capabilities.

Who You Are

You're a systems thinker who finds the engine room as exciting as the user-facing surface. You get energy from building consumer grade B2B experiences along with the connective data backbone tissue.
You're deeply AI-native as your actual operating mode and how you work every day. When you see a problem, your instinct is to open a tool and start prototyping, not schedule a meeting. By the time you present an idea, you already have something working.
You're comfortable being the only one of your kind. A blank canvas is energizing, and you thrive in an early-stage Series A environment.
You can hold your own anywhere: scrappy enough to debug a scan flow on the warehouse floor with three engineers, polished enough to walk a brand CFO through a value-realization report and make the ROI undeniable.
The people making circularity happen at the largest brands in the world have previously been handed clunky enterprise tools for decades, and you are genuinely excited to build them something better.

Experience We're Looking For

Required:
AI-native workflows as your actual day-to-day: you can describe what you built with them in the last month
A deep understanding of how to define, ship, observe, and manage user-facing AI powered products
Data product or system-of-record experience: defining where data is captured, designing chain of custody, building trustworthy reporting on messy real-world inputs
Built reporting for external stakeholders who made real decisions from it: finance, compliance, or executive audiences
Experience at a company under 200 people where you personally owned a product area with limited resources

Strongly preferred:
A specific story of turning custom or manual processes into a configurable platform ("we had N one-off builds, I collapsed them into one system")
Mix of early-stage (Series A–C) experience building from scratch and a scaled operations or data-heavy environment where you developed rigor and measurement discipline
Hands-on design of power-user or operator experiences: efficiency, error-proofing, information density, scanner ergonomics
Compliance or regulatory reporting background (duty drawback, EPR, financial reconciliation, or similar)
Background in recommerce, resale, WMS, fulfillment, fintech reconciliation, or supply-chain tech

Why Supercircle

We're the de facto technology and supply chain infrastructure for the post-sale economy. 100+ brands run on our physical AI network to route returns, excess, and trade-ins to their highest-value outcome, and we've already returned $50M+ to their P&Ls. As part of our team, you'll have the rare chance to be a market maker in a category where market, AI, and policy tailwinds are converging at once. If you're ready to define an industry and build with us, let's talk.
Email resume and portfolio to ashley@supercircle.world and include the position you are applying in the subject line of your email.
